role: A post-open mechanism attribution on the already consumed BLASTNet Case 7 result. It asks whether the K16-minus-fixed-Low64-K11 physical tail occupies a compact spatial subspace that transfers to a held-out camera rig. It is not a repair, replacement, predictor, prospective confirmation, or deployment method.
scientific_question: After holding out each of the thirteen frozen Case 7 rigs in turn, does the physical K16-minus-fixed-Low64-K11 correction for that rig lie within a rank-64 spatial subspace constructed only from the other twelve rigs, with at least 90 percent correction energy retained at the p90 level and at least 75 percent retained in the worst cell, including the late-frame failure interval?

values_not_computed_before_this_freeze: any leave-one-rig-out rank-16, rank-32, or rank-64 gate
the v236 formal or independent scientific decision

sealed_parent.root_role: private v235 result tree outside Git

leave_one_rig_out_primary.folds: For held-out rig h, the training rows are all 42 corrections from each of the other twelve rigs; all 42 corrections from h are held out.
leave_one_rig_out_primary.basis: Uncentered economy principal spatial subspace of the 504x8192 training correction matrix.
leave_one_rig_out_primary.formal_solver: Eigendecompose the 504x504 sample Gram matrix in descending order and explicitly reconstruct orthonormal physical basis rows.
leave_one_rig_out_primary.independent_solver: Direct economy SVD of each 504x8192 training correction matrix; do not import the formal runner.
leave_one_rig_out_primary.coefficient_role: Held-out correction is orthogonally projected with truth-aware oracle coefficients. This tests span capacity only; coefficients are not deployment-visible.
leave_one_rig_out_primary.threshold_interpretation: The p90 bound retains at least 90 percent correction energy and the worst bound retains at least 75 percent correction energy in every held-out rig.

fixed_control.name: frozen_v235_low64_physical_span
fixed_control.construction: Rebuild the same 64 tensor-product sine fields with one-voxel zero support and supported-interior zero-mean gauge. Formal uses QR; independent uses SVD.
fixed_control.projection_and_gates: Apply the same truth-aware orthogonal projection and the same all-frame and late-frame residual gates.
fixed_control.role: If this fixed span passes, the new tail subspace is not needed and the attribution is blocked.

decision_order: Any parent identity, shape, finite, norm, rank, orthogonality, fold, source, input, output-seal, formal-independent numeric, or discrete-decision mismatch gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE7_TAIL_SUBSPACE_ATTRIBUTION_V236.

If the unique leave-one-rig-out rank-64 primary fails any all-frame or late-frame gate in any rig, conclude FAIL_CASE7_LORO_TAIL_SUBSPACE_CAPACITY_V236 and close fixed global low-rank tail correction as an explanation of the v235 failure.
If the rank-64 primary passes but the frozen Low64 control also passes, conclude PASS_CASE7_TAIL_SPAN_BUT_LOW64_CONTROL_EXPLAINS_V236 and do not claim a distinct tail span.

Only if rank-64 passes every held-out-rig gate and the frozen Low64 control fails may conclude POST_OPEN_CASE7_LORO_TAIL_SUBSPACE_HEADROOM_V236. This only says that the v235 mismatch has a compact cross-rig physical correction span on the already opened Case 7 condition.
stop_rule: No v236 result authorizes a coefficient predictor, a changed v235 depth, basis, inverse, regularizer, threshold, fallback, unopened BLASTNet case, neural model, GPU, wall/RSS gate, curved ray, or real BOST claim. A separate result-before-training contract is required for any deployment-visible coefficient mechanism.
